points.description: Setup: labelled data with two classes (+/- or +1/-1) and weights initialised (e.g. randomly or to zero).
points.partial_credit: Only one of labels or weight initialisation mentioned.

points.description: Update rule: for a misclassified point (e.g. <w,x> <= 0 for the correctly signed/simplified input), update the weights by adding eta*x (Δw = η·x, with learning rate eta; sign by label is fine).
points.partial_credit: Update given but without learning rate, or without the misclassification condition, or with a minor error.

points.description: Loop structure: repeat over all data points/epochs until weights no longer change (or no misclassifications / converged); may note convergence since data is linearly separable.
points.partial_credit: Repeat mentioned but no stopping criterion.

rubric.notes: Full marks need pseudo-code with initialised weights, the perceptron update (Δw = η·x applied only to misclassified points), and repetition over epochs until the weights stop changing. Give part marks when one element is vague or missing, e.g. no learning rate, no misclassification condition, or no stopping criterion. Give no marks for answers describing a different algorithm or unrelated content. Steps and their order matter more than syntax.
